text:
I have committed the worst of sins
+
+a man can commit. I have not been
+
+happy. May the glaciers of oblivion
+
+drag me away and lose me, merciless.
+
+
+My parents engendered me for the beautiful
+
+and hazardous game of life,
+
+for earth, water, air, and fire.
+
+I failed them. I was not happy. Their youthful
+
+
+will was not fulfilled. My mind
+
+applied itself to the symmetrical contests
+
+of art, which interweaves trivialities.
+
+
+They bequeathed me courage. I was not brave.
+
+It does not leave me. Always at my side
+
+is the shadow of having been an unhappy man.

translation.title: I Have Committed the Worst of Sins…
translation.editorial_note: This separately hashed witness of “Remorse” preserves the same reviewed translation; its source differs only in the capitalization of the final line.
